implementation_issues.description: The paper uses historical Compustat item numbers for current taxes, pretax income and segment assets. A current local field-name match does not establish those historical item definitions, the current-tax denominator, or foreign-segment coding.
The article's broad ETR selection pool is 19,737 firm-years, while Table 4 equation (2) reports 16,750; the omitted column-specific screen is not explained.
Reconstructing MNC, FOROPER, the squared term, interactions, ETR cap at one and top/bottom 1% ROA trimming requires segment-code interpretation and sample-level screening.

review_notes: Table 4 column (2) is the selected broad-sample worldwide ETR equation. Domestic-only and multinational U.S.-incorporated firm-years are retained; later MNC-only analyses are not added.
The broad ETR pool and Table 4 column (2) observation counts differ (19,737 vs. 16,750); this remains an unresolved sample-definition gap.
